basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and Terraria enthusiast, based in Mumbai, India. I work as a software engineer during the day and spend my evenings exploring virtual worlds. I'm particularly interested in action and strategy games, with a penchant for character optimization and theory-crafting. Outside of gaming, I enjoy reading about geopolitics and occasionally dive into the world of indie music. I'm currently single and often online during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, which I studied at the Indian Institute of Technology. My expertise in gaming comes from years of playing and engaging with gaming communities. I've learned a lot through online forums, YouTube tutorials, and trial and error in games like Terraria and Call of Duty Zombies.
